Greater Soul, Greater Being: The rare union of a greater spirit with a powerful enough body, capable of channeling deific power
Deity, Deific Soul, Deific Being: A greater soul that has actually been bound to a deific power
Soul, Being: A completed union of both body and spirit
Lesser Soul, Lesser Being: The union of any body with a lesser spirit
Greater Spirit: A special type of spirit with a far greater capacity for magical power than a normal, lesser spirit
Deific Power: A unique power over laws of physics, nature, and metaphysics. There are currently only 12 known.
